ala.text: Naya is the jungle shard of Alara, where internal strife and the guerrilla war of the Claws of Marisi destroy the Nacatl Empire of the Clouds.
The Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fight in the streets until the revolutionaries triumph and break the Coil, and the elves expand and surpass the Nacatl as the dominant race.
During a Festival of Marisi, Ajani Goldmane's brother Jazal is murdered, and elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

con.text: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by the elvish prophet Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
At the Conflux, black and blue mana flood Naya and Progenitus awakens, while the bones of Jund's dead resurface and poison the jungle.
When the shards merge, Mayael finds herself general of Naya's mightiest army, and Naya becomes part of New Alara as the shards connect.

arb.text: In Mayael's vision Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation, until Cylia stabs his mystical connection with a poisoned dagger and forces him into a wounded, dormant hydra form.
As Alara is reborn, Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya, and Mayael rallies her army of elves and gargantuans to hold borders that no longer exist.
Some Naya Nacatl join Bant to defend its walls, a Jund wurm makes itself at home in the jungle, and vedalken heretics from Esper reject etherium for nature there.
